record.one_liner: Klaviyo API is a JSON:API compliant REST platform enabling read and write access to customer data, profiles, events, campaigns, and lists using private API keys or OAuth.

auth_methods.quote: Klaviyo provides 3 methods of authentication including private key authentication and OAuth (used to call server-side APIs) and public key authentication (used to call client-side APIs).

access_test.quote: You need a Klaviyo account. To keep test data out of your production account, create a test account first, and use it for every step below.

access_ship.quote: Building with an AI agent? See Set up your AI agent to give it these docs as Markdown, the OpenAPI spec and Klaviyo's MCP server.

api_type.quote: Every endpoint in the Klaviyo REST API, with its authentication, parameters, request and response bodies, and an example request.
